email.subject: Arctic Pros site is likely losing calls
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I checked Arctic Pros' website. Two things are probably costing you customers right now: it's not mobile-friendly (most people search for HVAC help on their phone, especially during a breakdown, and a broken mobile layout sends them straight to the next listing), and there are no customer reviews showing on the site, so visitors have nothing to confirm you're reliable before they call.

The pages are also slow to load from heavy images, which compounds both issues.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
